subject: Pavel Nedvěd (Pavel Nedved)
title: Nedved's national team: zero points, full confidence

lines.vo: Zero points in six games, and still full confidence?
lines.footage: Czech bench during a Nations League match, tight shot on a frustrated face

lines.vo: Pavel Nedvěd is the general manager, so every defeat lands on his desk. Busy desk.
lines.footage: Nedvěd at a press table, serious expression, arms folded

lines.vo: Three goals scored. Fourteen conceded. They did not lose those games. They donated them.
lines.footage: Czech goal-mouth scramble from the Croatia or England match, clean stadium audio

lines.vo: Three red cards in six games. Discipline was not on the team sheet. Neither were points.
lines.footage: Krejci or Sulc red card moment, VAR review shot

lines.vo: Seven straight defeats, the longest losing run in Czech national team history. Technically, a record.
lines.footage: Czech players walking off after the Spain or Croatia defeat

lines.vo: Nedvěd says a coach change is 'not up for discussion'. Full confidence in Santi Denia. Full confidence, zero points.
lines.footage: Santi Denia on the touchline, arms folded, close-up

lines.vo: The FIFA ranking agrees: fifty-third, the lowest since 2017, and now behind Peru. Peru.
lines.footage: Clean FIFA ranking graphic or Czech squad photo, no logos burned in
